title: THE HUMAN IS NOT THE ACTUATOR
semantic_thesis: Information can cross from Janus into a human decision and thereby participate in changing the physical or social world. That causal influence does not make the human a component owned or controlled by Janus.

ru: Слово Януса может изменить человеческое решение, но человек не становится его рукой в техническом смысле.
Причинное влияние можно признавать, не отнимая у человека авторство собственного выбора.
Там, где нельзя навязать fence, нужно ясно показать происхождение и статус слова.
en: A Janus output may change a human decision without turning the human into Janus's technical hand.
Causal influence can be acknowledged without taking authorship of choice away from the human.
Where a fence cannot be imposed, provenance and authority status should be made explicit.

boundary: Semantic interpretation only; no claim that humans are controlled by AI or that AI outputs determine human behavior.
